cases.description: The divisor indicator returns 2 for even indices and 0 for odd indices. Accessing an odd index should raise an ArithmeticException, while even indices return 5 (10/2).

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown when getValue(i) is evaluated

input.value: ConstantIndicator(2) based on BarSeries of length 5

cases.expected: IndexOutOfBoundsException thrown when getValue(i) is called for i >= 5
cases.description: The numerator NumericIndicator is built on a BarSeries with 10 bars, while the divisor indicator is built on a different BarSeries that only has 5 bars. Accessing an index beyond the divisor's size should result in an IndexOutOfBoundsException.
The divisor indicator deliberately throws an IllegalStateException from its getValue method. The exception should propagate through the division operation unchanged.

cases.description: A NumericIndicator created via NumericIndicator.of(null) has a null internal delegate. Dividing this indicator by a valid divisor should cause a NullPointerException when the resulting indicator attempts to read the numerator's value.
